name: Lares (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: The flag of the Grito de Lares: quartered blue over red by a white cross, with a white star in the upper hoist quarter.
history: Lares is a mountain town and municipality of central-western Puerto Rico. Its flag is the banner of the Grito de Lares revolt of 23 September 1868 against Spanish rule, designed at the behest of Ramón Emeterio Betances after the Dominican flag and first sewn by Mariana Bracetti; the Municipal Assembly proclaimed it the official flag of the municipality in 1952.
